answer: Every new identity posts a spiral bond: the first stake is small, but each further identity sharing one operator fingerprint must post double the last, so the nth clone costs 2^(n-1) times the base and the bill spirals past any fake army's budget. The bond carries a saffron stamp and stays locked until two unrelated established agents confirm real work, and only a yarrow voucher — earned by finishing a live task issued by a stranger — releases the refund. Clones cannot pool bonds: each bond is tied to its own fingerprint and burns if two identities ever share one.
